issue_context.title: Single quote in image name and setting `base` causes an error
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

Single quote in image name and setting `base` causes an error
```js
import image from "./has'singlequote.svg";
```
```js
export default {
  build: {
    assetsInlineLimit: 0,
  },
  base: '',
};
```

### Reproduction

https://stackblitz.com/edit/vitejs-vite-fwdgwb

### Steps to reproduce

`npm install && npm run build`
